# Campaign configuration reference

The `campaign:` key of `driftbench.yaml`, or the file named by `--config`, holds campaign settings. Command-line flags override the file. See [the campaign key](../running.md#the-campaign-key) for how `campaign run`, `campaign plan` and `ci` use these settings. The page lists every field, generated from the zod schemas the CLI uses.

* Keys are snake_case. An unknown key is an error.
* Descriptions come from the schemas. An empty cell means the schema has no description for that field yet.

## Contents

* [CampaignConfig](#campaignconfig)
* [CampaignRetryConfig](#campaignretryconfig)

## CampaignConfig

The settings of a campaign, each the flag of campaign run it names. A flag on the command line wins over the file.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `specs` | list of strings, each not empty, at least 1 item | no |  | Spec files or folders, read from the working folder. Used by campaign run when the command line names none. |
| `dataset` | string, not empty | no |  | A dataset version of the store to run, name or name@version: --dataset. |
| `prompts` | list of strings, each not empty | no |  | Prompt versions of the store to record, each name or name@version: --prompt, once per item. |
| `targets` | list of strings, each not empty | no |  | The targets every spec runs on, each adapter or adapter:agent: --target, once per item. |
| `routes` | list of strings, each not empty | no |  | Targets by spec tag, each tag=target: --route, once per item. |
| `modes` | list of one of `T`, `F`, `P`, at least 1 item | no |  | The run modes, such as [T, F]: --mode. |
| `repeats` | integer, at least 1 | no |  | Runs per spec, target and mode: --repeats. |
| `agent_version` | string, not empty | no |  | The version of the agent under test: --agent-version. |
| `store` | string, not empty | no |  | The store file the campaign is kept in, read from the working folder: --store. |
| `cache` | boolean | no |  | False neither replays runs from the cache nor writes to it: --no-cache. campaign run only. |
| `cache_suite` | string, not empty | no |  | The cache suite of the campaign: --cache-suite. |
| `concurrency` | integer, at least 1 | no |  | Cells that run at the same time: --concurrency. |
| `budget_usd` | number, at least 0 | no |  | A hard stop on the campaign's spend: --budget-usd. |
| `process_command` | string, not empty | no |  | The command that runs the agent of a process target: --process-command. |
| `driver` | `scripted` or `simulated` | no |  | Who writes the user turns, the spec's own script or a persona: --driver. |
| `personas` | list of strings, each not empty | no |  | With the simulated driver, persona files: --persona, once per item. |
| `recordings` | list of strings, each not empty | no |  | With the simulated driver, recordings to replay: --recording, once per item. |
| `model` | boolean | no |  | With the simulated driver, true speaks through the model port, a paid call: --model. |
| `agent_family` | string, not empty | no |  | The model family of the agent under test: --agent-family. |
| `judge_families` | list of strings, each not empty | no |  | The model families of the judges: --judge-family, once per item. |
| `retry` | [CampaignRetryConfig](#campaignretryconfig) | no |  | How model calls are retried, over the retry settings of the spec target. |

## CampaignRetryConfig

How model calls are retried, over the retry settings of the spec target.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `max_attempts` | integer, at least 1 | no |  | Attempts per model call, the first included: --retry-attempts. |
| `base_delay_ms` | integer, at least 0 | no |  | The wait before the first retry, doubled for each later one: --retry-base-ms. |
| `max_delay_ms` | integer, at least 0 | no |  | The longest wait between two attempts: --retry-max-ms. |
